dict.string: MeetPilot uses your microphone only while you have started capture, to transcribe what you say. It never joins your meetings.
MeetPilot captures audio playing on this Mac (for example, your meeting) only while you have started capture, to show you a private transcript. It never joins your meetings.
On macOS 13–14.5, system audio is only available through Screen & System Audio Recording. MeetPilot requests audio only and discards the video frames.
